name: Two sticks
blurb: Two sticks share one walk. The field around them is open.
aside: Both sticks are the corners of one walk: up column A, across row 4, and up column F. The treats at A8 and A6 are on that walk. The line that skips the ball scores −10. The ball at B9 is two steps off the start. She can take it and still reach the flag, and that line scores −9. It is the best line.
